question: Should plain-text copy be a per-click format choice beside Markdown, or a persisted default-copy preference?
rationale: Both approaches satisfy the request but create different UI and state surfaces; current code, shipped behavior, and discussion do not establish the intended product choice.

options.title: Per-click format menu
options.body: Keep the shipped Markdown default and offer plain text on each copy action without adding stored settings.

options.title: Persisted copy preference
options.body: Add preference UI and persistence so users can globally change the default copy format.

recommendation.title: Per-click format menu
recommendation.body: Keep the shipped Markdown default and offer plain text on each copy action without adding stored settings.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the existing behavior and supplied prior item-specific review context.
